top_categories.workout_context: 116ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Reliance Tennessee Gravel's Cherokee National Forest gravel, Chunky forest roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 70 miles.
At Reliance Tennessee Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Reliance Tennessee Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
8,100ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Reliance Tennessee Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Reliance Tennessee Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
8,100ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Low-cadence force work for 8,100ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
70 miles on cherokee National Forest mountain gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on cherokee National Forest mountain gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Reliance Tennessee Gravel’s 70 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Reliance Tennessee Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on cherokee national forest mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: cherokee national forest gravel, chunky forest roads, steep mountain climbs and descents.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 70 miles of cherokee national forest mountain gravel in Reliance, Tennessee.
